transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening after my cataract surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. It’s best to avoid heavy work, though, for 1 month.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. My next question is about using my eye gel for dry eyes. When can I start using it again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you were told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's great to hear. I'm also experiencing sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal after cataract surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s mild, it can help to wear sunglasses when you go outside. But strong pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, especially with a red and painful eye, is not normal and may need to be checked.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the advice. Lastly, I wanted to ask if it's normal to still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
